title: Verify clicking a product card from the unfiltered listing opens a valid product detail page
preconditions: Products page is loaded, no filters or search query active

test_data.card: first product card in the unfiltered listing

steps: Click the first product card in the listing
expected_result: A valid product detail page opens (no 404, no blank page, no console errors); the page content corresponds to the clicked product (matching product name/title).

title: Verify clicking a product card from filtered results opens the correct product's detail page
preconditions: Products page is loaded with 'Smart Glass' category filter active (3 products shown)
steps: Check the 'Smart Glass' category checkbox and wait for the filtered results
Note the name of one of the filtered product cards
expected_result: The product detail page that opens matches the exact product that was clicked (name/title on the detail page matches the card noted in step 2), not a different product from the unfiltered set.

title: Verify navigating back from a product detail page opened via search results returns to the products page with the search query preserved
preconditions: Products page is loaded, no filters or search query active
steps: Search for 'glass' and wait for results to load
Click on one of the returned product cards to open its detail page
Use the browser Back button to return to the products page
expected_result: The products page reloads with the 'glass' search query still active in the URL (?keyw=glass) and the same search result set displayed, not a reset to the full unfiltered list.

title: Verify directly navigating to a non-existent product detail URL shows an appropriate not-found state instead of crashing
steps: Check the browser console/network tab for a 500 error or unhandled exception
expected_result: Page shows a proper 404/not-found state (or a graceful redirect to a valid page), with no 500 error, no unhandled exception, and no blank/broken page.
